recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not re-add Sequence, MolecularSequence, or MolecularDefinition to the Patient compartment in core unless a future CG decision reverses the later MolecularDefinition decoupling/replacement model and makes a build-scope resource patient-specific again.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive STU3 issue asked to add the then-current Sequence resource to the Patient compartment because it represented patient genetic data and was missing from the Patient compartment definition.
initial_application: Commit 2e96a94 added Sequence to the Patient column in source/compartments.xml, matching the Jira applied-change comment. Commit 78abae0217 then implemented FHIR-19453 by renaming Sequence to MolecularSequence while preserving the Patient compartment mapping and fhir.ini patient categorization.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread said Sequence belonged in Patient only as then defined and would not if CG made it definitional. Later FHIR-51227 was Applied for R6 to replace MolecularSequence with MolecularDefinition and explicitly decouple genetic data from patient/encounter context; the combined branch already contains an audit for FHIR-51227.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current fhir.ini excludes Sequence, MolecularSequence, and MolecularDefinition from the active resources list; source/molecularsequence is absent; source/compartments.xml has no MolecularSequence or MolecularDefinition Patient-compartment row; and MolecularDefinition search parameters do not include patient or subject.
